title: OpenRouteService Matrix Request
description: Request body schema for the OpenRouteService Matrix API endpoint

locations.description: Coordinates as [longitude, latitude] pairs. Used as both sources and destinations unless specified. Maximum 3,500 in standard plan.

sources.description: Indices into locations array to use as origins. If omitted, all locations are used as sources.

destinations.description: Indices into locations array to use as destinations. If omitted, all locations are used as destinations.

metrics.description: Metrics to compute for the matrix

resolve_locations.description: Return nearest road network location information for each coordinate

units.description: Distance units (only used when distance metric is requested)

id.description: Arbitrary identifier echoed back in the response
